name: const unsafe fn copy_from_nonoverlapping (self , src : * const T , count : usize) where T : Sized ,
rule: The memory region beginning at `src` of size `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes must not overlap the memory region beginning at `self` of the same size.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * mut T { const unsafe fn copy_from_nonoverlapping (self , src : * const T , count : usize) where T : Sized , }
